items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t even know Max man.

ctx.x: Okay. Well then that’s good, that’s good that we’re able to -- so Max had no impact?
I didn’t even know Max man.
You didn’t know who Max was?

items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We both played -- when Basin Street opened here the first time, they booked Max and they booked me and so they wanted, you know, for publicity -- so east coast versus west coast.

ctx.x: You know, what am I going to play? You keep playing all my music. So he went on. Man, he wasn’t speaking to me for a while. But anyway it happened. But we had a thing man, there was group -- the success of the group was absolutely fantastic. We virtually started the west coast/east coast -- that thing that started the east coast jazz, west coast. You know how that came about? It came about because of me and Max Roach. We both played -- when Basin Street opened here the first time, they booked Max and they booked…
